comment: The rule that the consuming side should provide the adapter may not work in all integration scenarios. The party best able to create and maintain an adapter depends on ownership, expertise, data quality, procurement, and interface control.

anchor.note: p.74 l.Lines 831-838 read as the printed page; section 3.6.2 agrees

public.text: The rule that the consuming side should provide the adapter may not work in all integration scenarios. The party best able to create and maintain an adapter depends on ownership, expertise, data quality, procurement, and interface control.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace the fixed rule with a responsibility principle: adapter ownership should be assigned explicitly to the party best positioned to preserve meaning and maintain the mapping, with governance approval and clear accountability.
